description: Deletes ONE question/item of a question bank and touches nothing else. On a never-published item the delete is immediate and permanent; on a published one it only leaves the DRAFT - a live Riddle keeps drawing that item until question_bank_publish purges it, and question_bank_discard_changes brings it back until then. Permanent once purged: there is no trash and no restore. Rejected for a public template id. Needs full access: riddle://reference/concepts/access.

questionBankId.description: The ID of the question bank the item belongs to.

questionBankItemId.description: The ID of the item to delete, as returned by question_bank_get_items or question_bank_item_add.

name: question_bank_item_delete
